claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Joe Goss in 1876 on the Kentucky side of the river near Covington.
claims.excerpt: fought Joe Goss on the Keutucky side of the river near Covington

claims.statement: The whole party, including Allen, was arrested at the 1876 fight, and later the spectators were tried in the Covington courts.
claims.excerpt: The whois, party was arrestet atthe time, and jater the spectators were tried in the Covington eourrs

claims.statement: After the Goss fight Allen took a steamer to England and took up residence there.
claims.excerpt: Allen took a steamer sbout thag time and we), Eugland, where he took up his residence

claims.statement: After returning to America, Allen came to St. Louis.
claims.excerpt: After reiurujng to America he came to St. Lous

claims.statement: Allen was arrested several days before 13 February 1884 at Farrell's instance, to await a Kentucky requisition.
claims.excerpt: at his instance Alien wag arrested several days ago to await the arrival

claims.statement: At the 13 February hearing Allen's side argued that Farrell's proceedings were simply an attempt to collect a debt.
claims.excerpt: were simply an aliempt to Coilect adeht by Mr. Farrell

claims.statement: Judge Noonan released Allen from custody, saying the case would never have been instituted had the money been paid.
claims.excerpt: if the mouey had been paid two the compiiinant,fand Allea wag accordingly released from custocy

claims.statement: After hearing both sides, the Prosecuting Attorney said he would not press the matter against Allen.
